description: Accept an entire request iff it fits; rejected requests leave used unchanged.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.header:
method Reserve(used: int, req: int, cap: int) returns (next: int, ok: bool)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap
  requires req >= 0
  ensures ok == (used + req <= cap)
  ensures next == (if ok then used + req else used)
  ensures 0 <= next <= cap

reference.Reserve:
if used + req > cap { next := used; ok := false; }
  else { next := used + req; ok := true; }

mutants.violation: Removing the acceptance guard overallocates used=3 req=8 cap=10.
